title: buildzr config file (buildzr.yaml, version 1)
description: buildzr.yaml: the workspaces folder and the build options. Text values may use ${NAME}, ${NAME:-fallback} and $$; they are expanded when a command uses them, so values that contain '$' are only checked for their type here. Secrets never go in this file. Relative paths are relative to the folder holding the file. The loader (buildzr.site.config) is the authority; this schema lets editors check the same rules.

workspaces.description: The workspaces folder: the Python files in it create the workspaces. A single .py file path also works. Default: workspaces.

k.description: Room for a box that contains other boxes, in areas of an empty box; raise it if their insides are too small to read, lower it for compact diagrams.

text_color.description: Text colour on boxes, wcag or c4.

viewer.description: false builds data only, without the viewer.

out.description: The build output: build writes one folder per workspace here and serve reads it.
